text:
sophia: quick heads-up: noticed a sharp provisional token spike during this morning's canary fallback. a number of streaming sessions ended with provisional>confirmed because the router cut a toolcall midstream when swapping models. dropping a short repro + logs below.

kevin: can you paste the repro and example logs? curious if this repros locally or only under traffic.

sophia: repro (curl):
```bash
curl -s -N -H 'Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD' \\n  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \\n  -d '{"model":"opt-3b-quant","stream":true,"input":"<very long prompt>"}' \\n  https://api.redwood.example/v2/generate?route=router-v3
```
router log excerpt: (trimmed)
```
[10:11:02] req=req_7c4d route=router-v3 -> shard-b: session s-77 created
[10:11:09] s-77 model_swap scheduled: opt-3b-quant -> opt-3b-8bit at 20%
[10:11:13] s-77 toolcall:streaming:start
[10:11:14] s-77 toolcall:router-truncate(reason=model_fallback) closing session; provisional_tokens=128; confirmed_tokens=0
```

jamie: seen this before. our current policy keeps tokens provisional until we get an explicit finalize. if the router force-closes (truncation) and doesn't issue a finalize/confirm, the provisional rows never move to confirmed and show up as noise on billing/usage charts.

maya: console impact is visible in the usage tile. UX suggestion: add a "tentative" filter (tentative = provisional without finalized_at). also add a small link to sample session ids so support can click-through. telemetry-wise: surface a per-route metric for session_finalization_lag and count of sessions with closed_reason = 'truncated'.

kevin: two implementation paths I see: (A) router calls ledger to confirm/finalize server-side, or (B) rely on clients to send a finalization header/event. both have tradeoffs: server-owned confirmation is simpler for correctness, client confirmations can be spoofed/replayed. thoughts?

sophia: prefer server-owned confirms from router/serving layer. router knows when it completed work or intentionally truncated. client confirms are fragile across retries and network blips unless we add a robust idempotency/dedupe layer.

jamie: proposed API (internal):
POST /internal/sessions/{session_id}/confirm
payload:
```json
{"confirm":true|false, "final_tokens":123, "last_seq":456, "reason":"completed|truncated_by_router|client_eof|error"}
```
semantics: idempotent keyed by (session_id, last_seq). ledger should ignore duplicate confirms for same pair and prefer the highest final_tokens when multiple confirms with same last_seq arrive. if confirm=false ledger marks session as finalized_tentative and applies provisional-only billing rules.

kevin: agree on idempotency key. small add: include a server_signature header from router to avoid accidental client-sent confirms; internal mTLS already present but good to document. also document behavior when a later confirm arrives with a larger last_seq (treat as newer and accept).

maya: quick SQL I'd want for the dashboard (psql):
```sql
SELECT session_id, route, provisional_tokens, confirmed_tokens, closed_reason, last_heartbeat, finalized_at
FROM session_accounting
WHERE created_at >= now() - interval '24 hours'
  AND provisional_tokens > confirmed_tokens
ORDER BY provisional_tokens - confirmed_tokens DESC
LIMIT 100;
```
that feeds the tentative/provisional tile and lets support pivot by route and closed_reason.

deploy-bot: deploy: router-v3 canary -> 10% (10:11) :rocket:

infra-bot: auto-alert: routes with provisional_to_confirmed_ratio > 0.25 in last hour flagged. ticket AGENT-3099 created.

kevin: follow-ups/action items:
- infra: add histogram metric session_finalization_lag_ms + gauge provisional_to_confirmed_ratio by route
- eng-router: implement internal confirm endpoint (POST /internal/sessions/{id}/confirm), enforce server-side auth, add idempotency by (session_id,last_seq) and tests
- ledger: accept confirm payloads, ignore duplicates, store closed_reason enum, accept confirm=false semantics and mark finalized_at
- devex/maya: add tentative/provisional tile + clickthrough to session sample list; include a quick query link
- pm: decide on auto-finalize policy (suggestion: auto-finalize after 24h idle as "stale_finalized")

sophia: i'll open the router issue with the repro/logs and tag kevin/jamie. assigning eng-router to kevin and jamie for design/implementation.

jamie: will draft the router PR and ledger schema change tomorrow AM. will include migration for closed_reason enum. :thumbsup:

maya: creating dashboard ticket and will prototype a small UI mock.

kevin: one more note: some toolcalls intentionally cut the stream but are still semantically "completed" (e.g., generator hits max_tokens). confirm.reason must preserve that so billing doesn't treat those as errors.

sophia: good point. we will enumerate reasons: completed, truncated_by_router, client_eof, error, max_tokens_reached.

jamie: ok wrapping up. i'll include idempotency examples and expected ledger behavior in the PR description.

sophia: thanks everyone, keeping this thread updated as we iterate.
